title: SplitHive
headline: Distributed Real-Time Expense Ledger & Graph Simplifier
description: An open-source Splitwise alternative built for cross-platform expense sharing, real-time debt simplification graphs, and instant multi-user settlement calculations.
problem: Group expense sharing suffers from circular debt chains and race conditions during simultaneous multi-user settlements.
architecture: O(V+E) bipartite greedy debt minimization algorithm paired with Node.js/Socket.IO room multiplexing and MySQL ACID row-level locking (SELECT ... FOR UPDATE).
impact: Collapses N debts into at most N-1 transactions in < 2ms execution with guaranteed ledger consistency and sub-45ms real-time client sync.
highlights: MySQL ACID Row Locks (SELECT FOR UPDATE)

title: AI Transcription
headline: Sub-200ms Streaming Speech Recognition & Audio Pipeline
description: This web app showcases an AI-powered speech-to-text workflow that accepts recorded or uploaded audio, transcribes it with modern ASR models, and lets users review and export polished transcripts.
problem: Streaming high-resolution audio over WebSockets causes main-thread frame drops and excessive edge server egress costs.
architecture: Custom AudioWorklet node downsamples raw 48kHz audio to 16kHz mono PCM off the main thread before streaming to OpenAI Whisper ASR inference workers.
impact: Reduces network bandwidth by 66%, keeps main-thread UI frame budget under 1.5% load, and achieves sub-200ms end-to-end transcription latency.

title: Net Inspector
headline: Zero-GC Real-Time Network & Latency Diagnostic Telemetry
description: This diagnostic dashboard runs latency checks, port probes, and traceroutes to surface real-time network health insights with lightweight visual summaries for quick troubleshooting.
problem: Profiling hundreds of rapid network bursts and resource timings in single-page apps induces severe V8 garbage collection pauses and UI stutter.
architecture: Offscreen Web Worker utilizing postMessage(ArrayBuffer) transferable objects to write telemetry into an 8MB pre-allocated Float64Array ring buffer.
impact: Eliminates GC scavenging pauses entirely (0ms INP impact) and renders millions of timing traces at consistent 60 FPS via hardware-accelerated Canvas.
